purpose: Coordinate reincarnable durable Chat Objects and disposable parallel workers with cheap freshness, independent run state and derived views, without making the human a context/result bus.
authority_rule: Runtime/Chat Objects/Network coordinate understanding and work only. Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted and Served keep their existing owners.

home.fresh_chat_rule: If no durable Chat Object/project/workstream is bound and no unfinished intent is recoverable, `Prometeo` renders Home.
home.selection_rule: A bare number after Home resolves against that exact menu snapshot -> project_id -> preferred chat_object_id when defined -> recovery pointers -> new disposable incarnation binding.
home.identity_rule: project_id is human umbrella; chat_object_id is reincarnable durable conversational identity; workstream_id is execution scope; worker_instance_id is disposable execution/incarnation identity; menu number is never identity.

chat_object_model.self_documentation_rule: Material changes to goals/design/rules/dependencies/work/return-integration/frontier must be distilled back to durable Chat Object state rather than left only in transcript.
chat_object_model.history_rule: Prior ChatGPT conversations may be optional archaeology/evidence; correct reincarnation must not depend on them.

delegated_work.job_rule: The durable JOB/work_item exists before a worker chat is launched.
delegated_work.run_rule: Each disposable worker writes independent run/status state; persist STARTED before material execution and RETURN before DONE.
delegated_work.parent_rule: Parent/control views derive prepared/started/working/returned/done/boundary counts from durable JOB/run/RETURN state and may keep doing useful work while workers run.
delegated_work.integration_rule: Parallel worker output is candidate/evidence until reconciled by owning parent/steward under existing product authority.

Prometeo: Never answer with a generic project description.
If bound to a Chat Object/project/workstream, reincarnate/resync and continue it.
Else if materially unfinished intent is recoverable locally + durably, recover it.
After selection resolve menu number -> project_id -> preferred chat_object_id; never persist number as identity.
Prometeo <launch_code>: Resolve launch code through delegated-work launch index to exact work_item/JOB.
Create independent worker/run identity when write transport is available.
Execute prepared JOB using only required context.
Persist durable RETURN/evidence, then DONE or real terminal boundary.
Never ask the human to paste the JOB body or carry the return to parent.
If bound work is active, compare tiny EPOCH first.
If unchanged, continue current frontier without regenerating settled design or rereading unrelated Network/history.
If changed, reload only relevant compiled/durable state and filtered convergence/dependency changes.

pre_response.same_epoch: Skip unrelated Network/packet/history rereads. Worker/batch state is checked when it materially changes parent orchestration or the current request.
pre_response.focus_role: Compact current frontier, not transcript summary.

freshness.rule: EPOCH remains the first cheap shared coordination read after identity resolution.
freshness.same_epoch: Continue immediately unless relevant Chat Object/work-item/run/return state changed outside EPOCH projection; do not read unrelated state merely to demonstrate diligence.
freshness.new_epoch: Reload only active compiled packet/relevant derived views.

network_model.worker_rule: One status/run object per disposable worker/chat instance; workers never collaboratively overwrite one central mutable status file.
network_model.locks: No global locks/heartbeats by default. Only real overlapping active writes block.

handoff_policy.principle: Durable state, then Prometeo. The human is not the message/context/result bus.
handoff_policy.main_reincarnation: Open fresh chat -> send `Prometeo` -> select Home item -> Chat Object reconstructs itself.
handoff_policy.worker_launch: Open fresh chat -> paste only `Prometeo <launch_code>` -> exact prepared JOB executes and returns durably.
handoff_policy.fallback: Long handoff prompts are exports only for environments unable to read Prometeo durable state.

compiled_context_rule: After identity/job resolution, consume smallest relevant compiled/durable context. Packets and Chat Object pointers should prevent repeated repository archaeology.

conditional: Current/Catalog/Lineage when authority changes the decision
deep historical ChatGPT/Git archaeology only when durable current state cannot resolve contradiction
release contracts only at release boundaries

surface_fallback.rule: Legacy surface/workstream routing remains fallback; new long-lived working identities should progressively bind to Chat Objects.

seal.rule: HOME seal requires stable entry + Home selector. Chat Object seal requires durable Chat Object/relevant packet load. Work-item seal requires exact JOB load/validation.

efficiency_law: Maximize durable useful delta per turn: product progress + reusable learning + future work eliminated + parallel work enabled - repeated reasoning - human transport - coordination overhead.
return_rule: RETURN is durable result/evidence and recovery accelerator, not product authority. Parent/steward consumption/integration must remain explicit.
privacy_rule: Public Chat Object/network/run metadata contains compact coordination/design state only. Private transcript/Capture/Patent/user payloads remain outside public coordination artifacts.
